families.title: PolyQ: Codesigning End-to-End Quantization Framework for Scalable Edge CPU LLM Inference
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: uniform integer quantization -> fractional per-channel precision compiled into regular ISA quanta
limitations_locators: No dedicated Limitations section in exact v1; compiler/backend and evaluation boundaries are derived conservatively from #S3-#S5.
families.artifact_locator: No paper-specific public repository disclosed in exact v1.
families.mechanism_summary: Activation-aware per-channel error proxies feed waterfilling under a fractional bit budget; an ISA-aware snap stage and compiler permute/cluster channels into static packed bit blocks and assigned CPU kernels.
families.state_and_flow: Calibration owns channel errors; allocation owns nominal precision; compiler owns layout/permutation/kernel identity; runtime executes a static plan without request-time precision reconfiguration.
families.benchmark_contract: Falcon-H1-3B, Llama2-13B, Qwen3-32B; WikiText-2 plus five tasks; 128 calibration sequences, FP16 activations; Ryzen 9950X/7840U and Intel N250 Ubuntu 24.04, RAPL energy; group size 128; concurrency/SLO not disclosed.
families.claim_boundary: Supports author CPU quality/memory/throughput/energy results at matched disclosed budgets; does not prove GPU benefit, arbitrary ISA portability, serving-tail SLO, or universal fractional-bit superiority.
families.books_review: Target Ch49 execution-plan owner with Ch45/50 handoff; add nominal precision -> physical block/layout/kernel realization and require measured rather than nominal memory.

families.title: Action QFormer: Structured Representation Shaping under Action Supervision in Vision-Language-Action Models
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: direct action-loss rewriting of inherited representations -> mediated action-facing representation shaping
families.artifact_locator: No paper-specific public code repository disclosed in exact v1.
families.mechanism_summary: Action QFormer places learned queries between inherited image/instruction hidden states and the trajectory head, mediating action gradients so action-facing distinctions form without indiscriminately rewriting upstream multimodal tokens.
families.state_and_flow: Backbone owns inherited representations; QFormer owns action-facing representation; action loss crosses a controlled interface; trajectory decoder emits an H=8 local-frame action plan.
families.benchmark_contract: Single-frame navigation, zero-shot sim-to-real closed-loop scenes plus interface/gradient routing ablations; action representation and training details in Appendix A/B; hardware, precision, control frequency, multi-seed variance and safety SLO incomplete.
families.claim_boundary: Shows selected representation/closed-loop improvements; probes and Fisher/cosine diagnostics are not causal proof of general visual grounding or real-robot safety.
families.books_review: Target Ch26; add action-facing interface as gradient-authority boundary between semantic representation and policy adaptation, preserving direct fusion when data/viewpoint is narrow.

families.title: Reflex: Real-Time VLA Control through Streaming Inference
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: stop-think-act VLA serving -> asynchronous observation/action streams with bounded freshness
limitations_locators: No dedicated Limitations section; exactness applies only to partitioned attention for fixed inputs/window, while asynchronous prediction is empirical (#S3,#S4).
families.artifact_locator: Not Required — event-time artifact receipt was not reviewed and the repository is not part of the retained technical claim
families.mechanism_summary: A vision stream writes encoded observations to a partitioned ring buffer while a policy stream runs action expert/flow denoising; partitioned attention preserves fixed-window attention semantics, AdaRMSNorm stabilizes mixed precision, and a future-state predictor compensates delay.
families.state_and_flow: Vision stream owns observation versions; ring buffer owns partition/freshness; policy stream owns action generation; controller executes under asynchronous observation age and prediction error.
families.benchmark_contract: Author reports stable 50Hz and 2.58x acceleration on disclosed VLA setups; partitioned exactness is conditional, async/future prediction empirical; full hardware/precision/workload/control deadline must be taken from paper tables; production safety/failure recovery not shown.
families.claim_boundary: Demonstrates a co-designed runtime path, not that all VLA models can safely run at 50Hz or that predicted future cancels observation staleness under disturbances.
families.books_review: Target Ch26 with Ch49/56 handoff; add observation-version/freshness and asynchronous control deadline to VLA runtime contract.

families.title: Lights, Camera, Malfunction: When Illumination Robustness Leaves VLA Models Blind to Color
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: broad color augmentation -> invariant-feature collapse diagnosis -> semantics-preserving perturbation training
families.artifact_locator: Paper references SO-ARM100 hardware repository but discloses no unique paper implementation artifact.
families.mechanism_summary: FLARE searches illumination perturbations; naive HSV augmentation can improve attacked success by making policy ignore hue, so ChromaGuard fixes hue while perturbing other illumination axes to preserve color-dependent semantics.
families.state_and_flow: Environment lighting alters sensor evidence; augmentation policy owns allowed invariances; VLA emits action; physical evaluator separates task success from benign-to-attacked trajectory deviation.
families.benchmark_contract: LIBERO: SmolVLA 200k steps, 500 episodes/suite; real SO-101 dual-camera setup: SmolVLA/pi0.5 100k steps, 50/240 demos and 20/40 trials; TE only on benign-success/attack-failure subset; hardware/precision/control SLO not disclosed.
families.claim_boundary: Shows spotlight vulnerability and semantic collapse for selected tasks/models; FLARE/ChromaGuard are analytical tools, not exhaustive attacks or complete defenses, and temporal/adaptive attacks remain open.
families.books_review: Target Ch72 security, handoff Ch26; add semantic-invariance test: robustness gains must not be purchased by deleting task-critical sensor features.

families.title: FoMoVLA: Bridging Visual Foresight and Motion Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims

families.artifact_locator: No public paper-specific repository disclosed in exact v1.

families.state_and_flow: Current observation/instruction produce hidden image/foresight states; teacher tracker/future target provides training-only labels; deployed policy retains only learned representation and action head.
families.benchmark_contract: LIBERO/RoboCasa, strong VLA baselines and branch ablations; no added inference branch; hardware, precision, multi-seed variance and physical safety SLO not disclosed.
families.claim_boundary: Supports training-time representation shaping in selected simulated manipulation tasks; 2D view-dependent motion lacks 3D geometry and does not prove causal world dynamics.
families.books_review: Target Ch26; add training-only predictive supervision branch while preserving boundary from auxiliary future feature to persistent/causal world state.

families.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: sparse outcome RL/static skills -> policy-synchronous hindsight-skill on-policy distillation
families.artifact_locator: Not Required — event-time artifact receipt was not reviewed and the repository is not part of the retained technical claim
families.mechanism_summary: Current policy analyzes completed on-policy trajectories into hindsight skills; the same actions are rescored with/without skill context, producing dense token-level OPD signals jointly optimized with sparse outcome RL.
families.state_and_flow: Rollout policy owns trajectories; synchronized analyzer derives skill text; scorer computes contextual probability delta; trainer absorbs signal; analyzer/skill removed at inference.

families.title: CosFly-VLA: A Spatially Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Tracking
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Principle Reuse: visible-target tracking -> belief/state recovery under long occlusion
families.artifact_locator: No paper-specific public repository disclosed in exact v1.

families.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims
families.evolution_relation: Direct Evolution: absolute teacher imitation -> matched teacher/base reasoning delta with direction gate
limitations_locators: No dedicated Limitations section; lineage/top-k/short-run boundaries are derived from #S2-#S3.
families.artifact_locator: https://github.com/naver-ai/opd2 is post-window artifact verification and does not change v1 event date.
families.mechanism_summary: Token reward is teacher minus matched teacher-base log probability, centered under student top-k; delta magnitude is retained only when its sign agrees with ordinary teacher-student OPD direction.
families.state_and_flow: Student rollout defines visited state; teacher/base/student forward passes create dense token signal; sign gate filters conflict; trainer updates without scalar domain reward.
families.benchmark_contract: Qwen3/Gemma4 students 1.7B-8B, Math/Science/Code and 14 benchmarks; 100 steps, max 8k, top-k1024, AdamW 5e-6, vLLM; author reports extra compute/memory; long-run and lineage drift open.
families.claim_boundary: Supports matched-lineage reasoning distillation in disclosed models/tasks; does not prove cross-family deltas are compatible or that base difference isolates only reasoning.
families.books_review: Ch33 already contains matched teacher-base token delta, expectation centering, sign gate and Qwen/Gemma/short-run boundary.

families.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
families.revision_relation: v1 / first-public owner; later revisions excluded from event-time claims

limitations_locators: No dedicated Limitations section; attack scope/non-goals are explicit in #S3 and conclusion #S6.
families.artifact_locator: Not Required — event-time artifact receipt was not reviewed and the repository is not part of the retained technical claim

families.books_review: Ch72 already integrates BadWAM as imagination-preserving action attack and requires semantic prediction plus execution/action consistency.

Training-only foresight supervision clarifies the boundary to causal world state, but it does not alter deployed state ownership as broadly as the selected streaming VLA unit.

books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch26 states freshness/deadline/cancellation invariants but not the three-zone cache ownership, fixed-input exactness boundary or async observation-to-action timing contract.

Separate partitioned-attention exactness from asynchronous/prediction/mixed-precision empirical evidence.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/72-security.md — Sensor Robustness 不能删除 Task-critical Semantics
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch72 treats learned world/action checks as sensors but lacks a robustness invariant that distinguishes nuisance invariance from deletion of task-critical color or sensor semantics.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add benign semantic counter-task + attacked trajectory test before accepting augmentation defenses; preserve deterministic safety controls and disclose the static-spotlight/small-robot boundary.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-03-multimodal-world-models/26-multimodal-embodied-vla.md — Training-only Foresight 不是 Persistent World State
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch26 distinguishes latent predictive interfaces from explicit rollout but does not explicitly cover disposable training-only future/point supervision.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add auxiliary future-feature and point-motion supervision as a training branch whose runtime authority disappears; require ablation and do not relabel the learned feature as causal or persistent world state.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-04-training-system/33-grpo.md — Derived Skill 的 Utility 必须由当前 Policy 反事实验证
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch33 already covers scaffold annealing, state-matched distillation and hindsight relevance, but not a policy-synchronous skill analyzer with with/without-skill probability delta.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Insert offline skill pool -> latest-policy trajectories -> analyzer -> with/without-skill delta -> group-relative update. Analyzer remains a proposal source; environment outcome/verifier owns correctness.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-03-multimodal-world-models/26-multimodal-embodied-vla.md — Continual VLA 的 Adapter Timescale 与 Replay Frontier 属于 Policy Identity
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch26 covers data breadth/alignment and episode state but not how continual skill acquisition versions fast/slow adapters and replay-derived prefixes.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add fast/slow adaptation and bounded replay as an experimental lifecycle branch; preserve full replay and joint training where compute/storage permits and bind reset/order/cache/revision to evaluation identity.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-04-training-system/36-distributed-training.md — Long-context RL 先证明 State Lifetime，再证明 Gradient Boundary
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch36 already covers cross-phase state lifetime and dependency-driven reordering, but not the prompt/scratch/response replay proof ladder for multi-million-token RL under a fixed accelerator budget.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add capture -> disposable scratch -> paginated/offloaded prompt -> response-suffix replay -> backward ownership. Separate allocation feasibility, forward equality and full gradient correctness; retain disclosed missing gradient paths.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/66-evaluation-system.md — Security Agent 评估是一条 Cost-Success-Refusal Curve
books_comparison.existing_proposition: Ch66 covers run-level agent evidence, attack-budget curves, contamination and cost, but not their joint operating curve for offensive/defensive security agents.
books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add cost, success, refusal, tool/runtime policy and contamination as one versioned EvalRun surface; forbid causal model ranking from the observational non-random matrix.

books_comparison.target_ref: books/part-05-inference-system/45-why-kv-cache-speeds-up.md — Variable-rate Compression 把 Rank Allocation 变成 Request State

books_comparison.new_evidence_delta: Add deletion -> uniform rank -> variable rank continuum, basis revision/query/reuse identity, packed layout/kernel cost and exact fallback. Keep FullKV, quantization and token eviction as coexisting branches.
